entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Velma, how may I assist you today?
Yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse claim. It was denied! This is completely unacceptable. I use your products religiously.

I understand your frustration, sir. I'm showing here that your claim for the VeloBand Pulse was denied due to inconsistencies in the data logs regarding the reported incident. Can you elaborate further on what happened?

Elaborate? It malfunctioned during my marathon training! It gave me a faulty reading, causing me to push myself too hard and now I'm sidelined. This whole thing is a waste of time! I want it replaced.

I apologize that happened, sir. I understand it's frustrating. While the initial assessment flagged inconsistencies, let me take another look at your account. I see you're a VIP Platinum member. Thank you for your loyalty.
Platinum member? Exactly! I spend thousands with you people every year. And now this? I want to speak to your boss! I want to speak to your manager! This denial is unacceptable.

Sir, I understand your frustration and I want to help resolve this for you right now. Let me see what I can do. One moment please. Considering your loyalty status as a Platinum member, I can make an exception and approve the replacement of your VeloBand Pulse. How does that sound?
So, you're overriding the denial? Finally! Why didn't you just do that in the first place instead of wasting my time? I was about to ask to speak to your supervisor.

I apologize for the initial denial, sir. It was based on the preliminary data. However, given your valued Platinum status, I was able to override the decision for you. A replacement VeloBand Pulse will be shipped to you within 2-3 business days. You will receive a tracking number via email.
Okay, that's acceptable. Will it be the same model?
Yes, sir, it will be the same VeloBand Pulse model you currently own. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thank you for finally resolving this.
You're very welcome, sir. We appreciate your business and value you as a Platinum member. Have a great day!
